name: my personal hater
source:
Your life is going well until it doesn't. Right after you privatize your old channels post-trip into nostalgia, someone kidnaps you. And it's your only hater.

[From [url=https://sdf0aabd.itch.io/my-personal-hater]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的日子一直过得不错，直到突然变了样。怀旧了一番，把从前的几个频道设为私密后，你就被人绑架了。而绑架你的人，正是你唯一的黑粉。
